Voya Investment Management Lowered Deutsche Bank Ag (DB) Holding; Paradigm Asset Management Co Cut Its Apple (AAPL) Stake 
April 24, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc decreased Apple Inc. (AAPL) stake by 39.09% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc sold 11,300 shares as Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s stock declined 3.81%. The Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc holds 17,610 shares with $2.98B value, down from 28,910 last quarter. Apple Inc. now has $823.00B valuation. The stock decreased 1.84% or $3.04 during the last trading session, reaching $162.2. About 22.20M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Voya Investment Management Llc decreased Deutsche Bank Ag (DB) stake by 4.74% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Voya Investment Management Llc sold 23,503 shares as Deutsche Bank Ag (DB)’s stock declined 28.95%. The Voya Investment Management Llc holds 472,173 shares with $9.00 million value, down from 495,676 last quarter. Deutsche Bank Ag now has $30.40 billion valuation. The stock increased 3.16% or $0.45 during the last trading session, reaching $14.7. About 4.93M shares traded or 2.16% up from the average. Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft (NYSE:DB) has declined 18.76% since April 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.31% the S&P500.

(NASDAQ:AAPL). Mufg Americas Holdings reported 489,867 shares or 2.48% of all its holdings. Armstrong Henry H Assoc owns 19,902 shares. Accredited has 1.74% invested in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Outperform” on Wednesday, April 27.

AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 14.96 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality.
